title: Refereeing: the evolution of trust in editorial practices
lineage: Inspected the identified passage; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.locator: History of the Committee of Papers and referees
passages.note: Describes collective decisions by the Society from 1752 and the addition of explicit written expert reports in the early 1830s. A 1839 report is illustrated; this is not the origin of all expert review.
